original.target_description: Study 2a: high versus low need-for-cognition quintiles; standardized adjustment from self-generated anchors; independent-samples t test.

n.sample_role: Cornell undergraduate participants contributing to self-generated-anchor aggregate test
n.exclusions: 81 participated (42 high NFC, 39 low NFC); item-wise exclusion for not knowing/activating anchor. Analytic participant n is not explicitly printed; t(77) differs from total sample.
n.location: pp. 314–316, exclusion paragraph, Study 2a Procedure and Results
n.quote: Forty-two people from the top quintile and 39 from the bottom quintile participated

replication.target_description: Study 1: continuous need for cognition versus standardized absolute adjustment from self-generated anchors, German online sample; one-tailed Pearson correlation. This replaces original extreme-quintile contrast.

n.exclusions: 462 clicked link; 303 completed and survived exclusions. Excluded missing NFC scale and insufficient knowledge/activation of intended anchors; item exclusions for correct values, nonsensical values and item-wise outliers.
n.location: p. 10, section 4.2.1; p. 11, section 4.2.3; pp. 7–9, exclusions
n.quote: 303 completed the study and were not excluded by our exclusion criteria.

reported_success.quote: there were no correlations between need for cognition and susceptibility to anchoring.

notes: Titles verified against supplied references. Published replication has the target test on p. 11; supplied p. 15 does not locate Study 1 statistics in this version. Study identifiers and NFC description identify the target; for generic description Anchoring, Study 2a/Study 1 identify this NFC contrast. Original analytic n is left null because only total participation and test degrees of freedom are printed. No metric conversion performed.
